title: Nomad Station
description:
In the 22nd Century people have settled the near-side of the moon, building massive mining operations for the benefit of Earth, while neglecting the needs of the Lunar people. Tensions with Earth are building, and hit a boiling-point when in 2134 a rogue nation suddenly seizes as much Lunar property as it can with deadly force. As an MI6 agent, you are sent to a mining station taken over by enemy forces in the Hadley-Apennine region. Eliminate the invaders, and frustrate their efforts! You're on your own, so be resourceful. Fight for King and planet!A Lunar Environment
Feel how lunar gravity affects your gameplay. Achieve mad hops, send enemies flying, bounce around in the Lunar Pressurized Vehicle (LPV), or take off with a jetpack!Choose Your Weapons
Whether you are a gunslinger, heavy gunner, swordsman, or just like blowing things up, you will not be left out. Take on the enemy with a mixed arsenal of weapons that would otherwise weigh you down on Earth!Freedom of Movement
• Walk or run freely through the experience with smooth VR room-scale locomotion featuring 30 degree snap-turn for comfortable seated gameplay! Smooth player rotation is also supported as an option.

• Standing or sitting, the game knows the difference at all times so you do not have to pause the game to change between the two modes.

• No need to reach. Lightly hold the grip button and cast a laser to the objects you want to grab, then press fully to teleport them into your hand!
description_short: Become a master MI6 saboteur, and earn your name as the ministry's most important asset on the Moon in this 1st-person shooter VR sci-fi epic! Follow the orders of your handler, or explore and find new weapons and defenses! Do whatever it takes to complete your mission!
